# Development Build 54

Install wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev54_amd64.deb on Ubuntu 26.04 amd64. Finish active protected work and close its workspace normally before installing. Verify the installer against SHA256SUMS.txt.

Includes the transaction review countdown, readable expiry/re-review flow and locally derived wallet card icons. See ../AGENT_BUILD54_TRANSACTION_REVIEW.md. No Dashboard update required.
